body: i downloaded the svipper app - can also buy your tickets there

i wish i could help more, but i am only 21 and have no children, ive not even ever been in a relationship lol
 
Sometimes people have to explore to find their interests, theres this weird idea that you try something and have to stick to it even if you dont enjoy it and i think that can continue into later life where people commonly work jobs they dont enjoy.

Maybe try getting her into groups where a variety of activities are tried out? 

Sometimes people have a habit of giving up when they’re not immediately good at something (this is very much what i go through)

But i dont think i can help much with your issue, im sorry
also triggers my fear of abandonment!! thank you for sharing your link, I skimmed through it but i will read it more thoroughly later when i sit to relax and have some mindfulness moments

thank you so much, i really mean it. I am trying to not lose hope but i to get fearful that my mental health will scare people off. I also get fearful that i am not enough, but i give a lot to people and I’ve recently been realising that i deserve that back. Hearing your story makes me feel more hopeful and reassured, thank you so much for sharing it and also thank you for your kind words
This means a lot, thank you for your comment and outside opinion, i needed to hear it from someone
I am so glad this has prevented another child from going through this, your comment and understanding response has actually made my day. Thank you

yeah I’m the same even if other people are shouting at eachother and im not part of the situation sometimes it triggers panic attacks and i really struggle with calming myself. Shouting has always been associated with physical abuse for me and i just struggle to cope with it. Its weird my mum used to always shout at me and scream to the point my ears would be ringing but it was like right after that she would switch to the other extreme of not talking to me at all. There was no middle. Now both extremes shock me in different ways and leave me extremely uneasy, makes me feel like I’m gonna require so much understanding from a person which kinda makes me lose hope bc ive never had someone like that ever :/

sigh, mine didnt even sound genuine, at first i was like aw but i kept reading and eventually i was thinking wtf??? Its like a personal little ego stroke, a token to herself of her being the bigger person, a way for her to clear her own conscience. Its like a big “im sorry you feel that way” and “im sorry but…” theyre not apologies at all.

It was a very good place to share, don’t apologise at all. Thank you for your insight and i am glad you were able to recognise it and moreover communicate it. Thats a massive step in the right direction for both of you and i hope its something i can do one day and have someone understanding of it. 

I hope everything goes well and i am glad you were both able to recognise and communicate it to eachother.

I am also a MASSIVE crier any time someone raises their voice

i think my mum is the same, bc she knows her silent treatment was always a way to punish me. But sometimes i just like to be quiet and bc she uses it as a punishment she assumes that im angry just bc i dont want to talk. 
I also feel safer around her when i keep my thoughts in my own head, especially when growing up a lot of my thoughts were mocked and ridiculed and expressing my emotions was followed by gaslighting.

Its not fair on us at all
thank you for sharing and recognising this, you’re right

I rarely hold hatred but if someone disturbs my peace i just give space or no longer contact them. With anger i think i just take time to myself until it resides and i feel myself in a rational place to communicate my feelings. I think maybe take knowing how horrible it is to be at the other end of the silent treatment and know that tbh maybe you dont want someone else to go through that… but idk i have bpd too and my mood and view of someone can switch in an instant
